# Ibis

Source: https://ibis-project.org/docs

- 1
- Import Ibis.
- 2
- Enable interactive mode for exploratory data analysis (EDA) or demos.
- 3
- Read a Parquet file and specify a table name (optional).
- 4
- Display the first few rows of the table.
